fusions.name: Bodkin Point
fusions.desc: Fires a narrow-headed arrow that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Plate-Splitting Fan
fusions.desc: Looses a fan of heavy arrows 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 11 damage to everything in it, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 6 seconds, and knocks them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Pavise Stand
fusions.desc: Plants a pavise that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Arrow-Proofed
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 12% piercing resistance.
